title: RAIL in the Wild: Operationalizing Responsible AI Evaluation Using Anthropic’s Value Dataset
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to evaluating and benchmarking the ethical behavior and normative values of Large Language Models. It introduces the Responsible AI Labs (RAIL) framework to map AI-expressed values to ethical dimensions such as Fairness, Safety, and Accountability, and applies this framework to quantify the ethical performance of the Claude model.
